summary_en: Websites, IDX search, branding and campaigns for agents and brokerages.
summary_fr: Sites, recherche IDX, marque et campagnes pour agents et agences.

tools.name: Adapt Immo
tools.positioning: A long-established French agency suite covering transaction, rental management and the agency website.
tools.description: Adapt Immo provides French agencies with transaction software, rental management, websites and portal publishing, sold as an integrated suite with training and support aimed at independent agencies and small networks.
tools.real_estate_use: Many French agencies run transaction and gérance side by side under the same carte professionnelle. Keeping both in one suite avoids the duplicate owner and property records that appear when an agency buys a sales tool and a separate rental tool — a recurring source of error at the point where a managed property goes up for sale.
features: Transaction management with mandates and matching
Rental management with leases, receipts and owner accounts
Agency website and portal publishing
Prospecting and pige modules
Electronic signature integration
Document and legal file management

use_cases.job: Run transaction and rental management on shared owner and property records
Publish mandates to portals and the agency site from one catalogue

tools.name: AgentFire
tools.positioning: Hyperlocal agent websites — built to rank on the neighbourhood, not on the city.
tools.description: AgentFire builds WordPress-based agent and team websites with IDX search, and a large library of add-ons aimed at local authority content: neighbourhood guides, market reports, area pages, lead magnets and semantic SEO structures.
tools.real_estate_use: Competing for "homes for sale in Austin" is hopeless against the portals; competing for a specific neighbourhood is not. AgentFire's content structures exist for that strategy — an agent builds authoritative pages per area, and the site is designed to capture the long-tail searches those pages attract.
features: WordPress-based agent and team websites with IDX
Neighbourhood and area guide page structures
Market report and lead magnet modules
Semantic SEO structures for local authority
Custom design tiers and branding
CRM integration and lead routing

use_cases.job: Rank on neighbourhood-level searches the portals do not dominate
Publish area content that keeps producing leads years later

tools.name: Amenitiz
tools.positioning: An all-in-one property management system for independent hospitality — the small hotel, the gîte, the chambre d'hôtes.
tools.description: Amenitiz combines a property management system, a website builder with a direct booking engine, a channel manager, payment processing and revenue tools, aimed at independent accommodation providers rather than at professional rental managers.
tools.real_estate_use: The independent French hospitality operator — a guesthouse, a small hotel, a set of gîtes — typically has no website of its own and depends entirely on commissioned platforms. Amenitiz packages the site, the booking engine and the channel connections in one subscription, which is why it reaches operators who would never buy three separate tools.
features: Property management system for small accommodation
Website builder with direct booking engine
Channel manager across major booking platforms
Payment processing and deposit handling
Rate and availability management
Guest communication and review handling

use_cases.job: Get a bookable website and channel connections without assembling a stack
Manage rates and availability for a small property across every channel

tools.name: BoldTrail
tools.positioning: The brokerage-scale platform that grew out of kvCORE — websites, CRM, recruiting and back office under one roof.
tools.description: BoldTrail is Inside Real Estate's platform, the successor branding to kvCORE. It is sold at brokerage and enterprise level and spans agent websites, a CRM with automated campaigns, listing marketing, recruiting and retention tooling, and — through BoldTrail BackOffice (the former Brokermint) — commission and transaction accounting.
tools.real_estate_use: A multi-office brokerage standardises its agents on one system: each agent gets a branded IDX site and CRM seat, the brokerage keeps ownership of the lead database, and leadership sees production, recruiting pipeline and commission splits in the same tool. It is chosen for the consolidation rather than for any single best-in-class module.
features: Agent, team and brokerage IDX websites with lead capture
CRM with behavioural automation and mass texting
Listing marketing kits and social ad automation
Recruiting and retention module with agent production data
BackOffice for commission plans, disbursement and brokerage accounting
Marketplace of add-ons for ads, video and lead sources

use_cases.job: Give 500 agents a website and CRM without losing brokerage ownership of the data
Track recruiting targets against real production numbers pulled from the MLS

capabilities: AI content assistant for listing and campaign copy

tools.name: Cloud CMA
tools.positioning: The listing presentation an agent brings to the kitchen table, generated from the MLS in minutes.
tools.description: Cloud CMA builds comparative market analyses, buyer tours, property reports and listing presentations from MLS data. Its Live version turns the CMA into an interactive presentation shown on screen during the appointment, and Homebeat sends the owner an automatic valuation refresh over time.
tools.real_estate_use: Winning a listing is a persuasion problem, and the CMA is the artefact that does the persuading. The agent pulls comparables from the MLS, adjusts them, and produces a branded document that justifies a price the seller may not want to hear. Homebeat then keeps the relationship alive by mailing an updated valuation every quarter.
features: Automated CMA generation from MLS comparables
Cloud CMA Live interactive listing presentation
Homebeat recurring valuation emails to past clients
Buyer tour and property report formats
Customisable branded templates and pages
Lead capture from shared reports

use_cases.job: Produce a defensible pricing presentation from MLS comparables in minutes
Stay in front of past sellers with an automatic quarterly valuation email

tools.name: Hektor
tools.positioning: One of the reference transaction systems for French agencies — mandate, matching, portal publishing and website in a single subscription.
tools.description: Hektor is La Boîte Immo's real estate software for French agencies and networks: property and contact records, mandate management, automated buyer matching, portal publishing, electronic signature, and an agency website generated from the same catalogue.
tools.real_estate_use: A French agency's daily cycle runs on the mandate. Hektor holds the signed mandate and its legal mentions, matches each new listing against registered buyer criteria and sends the alert, publishes to the portals the agency subscribes to, and feeds the agency site. The reason it is bought as a suite is that in France the website and the portal feed are the same catalogue.
features: Property and mandate management with French legal mentions
Buyer criteria matching with automatic alerts
Multi-portal publishing from one catalogue
Agency website generated from the same listings
Electronic signature on mandates and offers
Pige and prospecting modules

use_cases.job: Match a new mandate against registered buyers and alert them the same day
Run listings, portal feeds and the agency website from one catalogue

tools.name: Lodgify
tools.positioning: A vacation rental website and booking engine first, with channel management attached.
tools.description: Lodgify provides vacation rental owners and small managers with a website builder and direct booking engine, channel manager synchronising with major platforms, reservation and calendar management, payment processing and automated guest messaging.
tools.real_estate_use: For an owner with two or three holiday properties, the practical question is whether to pay fifteen percent commission forever. Lodgify's proposition is a bookable site they own, with the channels kept as a fill mechanism — a different emphasis from the professional systems, which assume channels are the primary demand source.
features: Website builder with direct booking engine
Channel manager across major booking platforms
Calendar, rate and reservation management
Payment processing and damage deposits
Automated guest messaging and templates
Owner and property performance reporting

use_cases.job: Take direct bookings on an owned site instead of paying commission on every stay
Synchronise calendars across platforms for a small set of properties

tools.name: Lofty
tools.positioning: An all-in-one platform where the IDX website, the ad spend and the CRM are the same product, so a click is tracked to a closing.
tools.description: Lofty bundles an IDX website, lead-generation advertising, CRM, dialer, email and SMS marketing, and transaction tracking into one subscription. Renamed from Chime in 2023. Sold mostly to teams and brokerages that want a single vendor rather than a stack.
tools.real_estate_use: A team buys traffic through Lofty's ad management, the visitor lands on a Lofty IDX site, their property searches are recorded against their CRM record, and an AI assistant opens the conversation by text. The differentiator in daily use is behavioural triggering — the agent is alerted when a contact revisits a listing or saves a search, not on a calendar timer.
features: IDX website with agent, team and brokerage templates
Behavioural lead alerts driven by on-site property search activity
AI assistant that texts and qualifies inbound leads
Built-in dialer, SMS and drip email campaigns
Facebook and Google ad management with lead attribution
Smart plans and transaction pipeline

use_cases.job: Run lead generation, nurture and site under one vendor with one attribution report
Get alerted the moment a past lead resumes searching and re-engage the same day

tools.name: Luxury Presence
tools.positioning: Design-led websites for agents whose brand is the product — the high end of the agent site market.
tools.description: Luxury Presence builds and hosts agent, team and brokerage websites with IDX search, designed as brand properties rather than lead-capture funnels, alongside content, SEO, advertising and CRM tooling.
tools.real_estate_use: At the top of the market, a listing presentation is partly a credibility exercise: a seller with a seven-figure property judges the agent by the quality of their digital presence. Luxury Presence sells to that argument — design and editorial quality first, lead volume second — which distinguishes it from the IDX-plus-CRM platforms sold on cost per lead.
features: Designed agent, team and brokerage websites
IDX property search integration
Listing microsites for individual properties
SEO, content and social media services
Paid advertising management
CRM and lead management tooling

use_cases.job: Win high-end listings with a digital presence that matches the property
Give a team consistent branded sites without an agency per agent

tools.name: Netty
tools.positioning: Software and website sold as one product, with the agency site treated as a lead-generation asset rather than a brochure.
tools.description: Netty provides French agencies with transaction software — listings, contacts, mandates, matching, portal publishing — combined with a website builder, SEO tooling, electronic signature and rental management modules.
tools.real_estate_use: Independent French agencies compete with national networks whose brand carries the online traffic. Netty's positioning answers that: the agency site is built for local search visibility, and every enquiry it produces lands in the same system as the mandate and the portal leads, so an independent can measure whether its own site is out-earning its portal subscriptions.
features: Transaction management with mandates and matching
Agency website with SEO structures and lead capture
Multi-portal publishing and feed management
Rental management and lease modules
Electronic signature integration
Prospecting and pige tooling

use_cases.job: Measure whether the agency's own website out-earns its portal subscriptions
Publish a new mandate to every portal and the agency site in one action

tools.name: Poliris
tools.positioning: Software, website and distribution from one French vendor, with a long history in portal feed management.
tools.description: Poliris supplies French agencies with transaction software, agency websites and listing distribution to portals, historically as one of the main feed operators in the French market. Its own domain no longer resolves and its former address redirects to Orisha Real Estate, where the Poliris name does not appear: whether the product still ships under this brand is unresolved.
tools.real_estate_use: Its practical value to an agency is the same as Ubiflow's — one catalogue, many destinations — with the software and the site included rather than integrated. Agencies that do not want to assemble a stack from three vendors buy the whole chain here and accept the trade-off of less choice at each layer.
features: Multi-portal listing distribution
Transaction software with listings and contacts
Agency website generation
Lead consolidation across channels
Media and format handling per portal
Reporting on publication and lead volume

use_cases.job: Buy software, website and portal distribution from a single vendor
Keep one catalogue as the source for every published channel

tools.name: Previsite
tools.positioning: Content production and distribution suite for real estate agents: photo, video, virtual tour, a dedicated site per listing and social media publishing.
tools.description: Previsite publishes a set of marketing tools for real estate agents, gathered in an all-in-one mobile application called Smartpix Pro. The application produces the visual content of a listing — optimized photographs, dynamic videos and virtual tours — with the vendor stating a professional-quality result in under five minutes. Around it sit a dedicated single-property website for a mandate, and Social Connect Pro, a turnkey product that manages an agency's social accounts, distributes listings automatically and works on local visibility. Other named products include Mooveo and SpotVideo. The company is French, with offices in Hyères and Paris.
tools.real_estate_use: An independent agent who has just signed a mandate is expected to be photographer, videographer and community manager on top of the job itself. With Previsite they shoot the property on a phone through Smartpix Pro, which returns edited photos, a video and a virtual tour without a studio pass; the mandate gets its own single-property page to send to the owner as proof of work and to buyers as a landing page. Social Connect Pro then pushes the listing to the agency's social accounts on a schedule the agent does not maintain by hand, which is what keeps a small agency visible locally between listings.
features: Application Smartpix Pro regroupant photo, vidéo et visite virtuelle
Photographies optimisées et vidéos d'annonce assistées par IA
Visite virtuelle consultable à distance par l'acquéreur
Site mandat dédié à un bien
Social Connect Pro — gestion et diffusion automatique sur les réseaux sociaux
Diffusion des annonces pour la visibilité locale de l'agence

use_cases.job: Produire photos, vidéo et visite virtuelle d'un bien depuis un téléphone, sans prestataire externe
Tenir la présence de l'agence sur les réseaux sociaux avec une diffusion automatique des annonces
Donner à un mandat son propre site pour le montrer au vendeur et le servir aux acquéreurs

capabilities: Assisted video generation from listing media

tools.name: Prospeneo
tools.positioning: All-in-one French real estate CRM for agencies and mandataire networks, sold as separate applications for prospecting, sale and rental, marketing and websites.
tools.description: Prospeneo is a French real estate CRM published by Facilogi and sold to independent agencies and to networks of mandataires. It is organised as applications rather than one monolith: prospecting, sales and rentals, callback scenarios, automations, email marketing, landing pages, forms, teams and privileges, and analytics. The sale and rental application covers listing creation with AI-assisted copywriting, a media manager, contact records and buyer-to-listing matching with a detailed matching view. A separate website line called Vitrinellis provides agency sites built for lead capture, with search, high-definition photos, video and virtual tours, social sharing, geolocation, moderated customer reviews, a gateway to the transaction software, and embeddable popups, forms, pages and newsletters. Website pricing is published from €69 per month for the Starter subscription and €89 for Essentiel, with a setup fee.
tools.real_estate_use: A mandataire network has a structural problem an agency does not: several hundred independent agents, each with their own listings and contacts, who must be equipped identically and supervised without being employees. Prospeneo answers it with team and privilege management and per-agent analytics sitting on top of the same CRM, and by selling the pieces separately so a solo mandataire and a network head office do not pay for the same thing. In daily use the centre of gravity is matching: a new listing arrives, the software proposes which registered buyers fit it, and the callback scenarios make sure none of them is forgotten for three weeks. The website line matters because for a mandataire the site is the shopfront, there being no physical one.
features: Sale and rental listing management with AI-assisted listing copywriting
Buyer-to-listing matching with a detailed matching view
Contact records and prospecting pipeline
Callback scenarios and marketing automations
Email marketing, landing pages and forms
Team and privilege management with per-agent analytics

use_cases.job: Match a new listing against registered buyers and be reminded to call them
Equip a network of mandataires with one CRM and see each agent's activity

tools.name: Real Geeks
tools.positioning: An affordable IDX site and CRM pairing aimed at the individual agent and the small team.
tools.description: Real Geeks provides IDX websites, lead capture, a CRM with automated follow-up, and Facebook and Google ad management as a managed service. It sits at a lower price point than the brokerage platforms and is commonly the first real system an agent buys after outgrowing spreadsheets.
tools.real_estate_use: A solo agent or a two-to-five person team replaces a brochure website with a searchable IDX site, runs a small monthly ad budget through Real Geeks' managed campaigns, and lets the CRM chase the resulting registrations with SMS autoresponders. Property valuation landing pages are the standard seller-lead play.
features: IDX website with map search and forced registration options
CRM with lead assignment, SMS autoresponders and drip campaigns
Property valuation seller-lead landing pages
Managed Facebook and Google ad campaigns
Market report emails triggered by saved searches
Agent and team accountability dashboard

use_cases.job: Turn a small monthly ad budget into registered buyer and seller leads
Capture seller leads through home valuation pages and nurture them for months

tools.name: Sierra Interactive
tools.positioning: A search experience fast enough to rank, wired directly into the CRM that works the leads it produces.
tools.description: Sierra Interactive sells an IDX website plus CRM aimed at teams that generate their own organic and paid traffic. The product is known for site performance and SEO structure — neighbourhood and market pages built to rank — with lead routing, action plans and a dialer on the CRM side.
tools.real_estate_use: Teams that treat their website as the lead source, not as a brochure, use Sierra to build hundreds of hyperlocal landing pages, capture registrations behind listing detail, and drop the registrant straight into a routed follow-up plan. The value is measured in organic lead volume and cost per lead against portal pricing.
features: High-performance IDX search with map, polygon and school filters
SEO-oriented market, neighbourhood and community page builder
CRM with lead routing, action plans and accountability reporting
Integrated dialer, SMS and email marketing
Listing and open house landing pages
PPC and lead-source attribution reporting

use_cases.job: Rank on hyperlocal searches and convert organic traffic into registered leads
Hold agents accountable to response time on self-generated web leads

tools.name: Ylopo
tools.positioning: Advertising and AI follow-up bolted onto the CRM a team already uses, instead of replacing it.
tools.description: Ylopo runs paid lead generation on Google and Meta, provides branded home search sites, and layers AI text and voice follow-up on top of an existing CRM — most commonly Follow Up Boss — rather than asking a team to migrate.
tools.real_estate_use: Teams that already standardised on a CRM will not move for an ad product. Ylopo's design reflects that: it generates and nurtures, and writes everything back into the CRM of record. Its dynamic listing ads and seller-lead products are the practical draw, with AI voice follow-up handling first contact at scale.
features: Managed Google and Meta advertising for buyer and seller leads
Branded home search sites with behavioural tracking
AI text and AI voice follow-up on new and aged leads
Dynamic remarketing ads featuring listings a lead viewed
Seller lead products with valuation landing pages
Write-back into an existing CRM rather than replacing it

use_cases.job: Add paid acquisition and AI follow-up without migrating off the current CRM
Retarget past site visitors with the specific homes they looked at

capabilities: AI text and voice lead follow-up
